S, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in Criminal Case No.110 of 2016 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 114, 498A, 323 and 504 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2. The petitioners and respondent No.2 have settled the dispute amongst themselves before this Court in Miscellaneous First Appeal No.426 of 2019 (FC) by drawing up certain terms of settlement.
One of the terms of settlement includes co- operation for closure of the present proceedings.

The said paragraph reads as follows:
NC: 2024:KHC:47026 "3.

Today the appellant Sri Shiva Prakash and the respondent Smt. Nagamani @ Mamatha are present before the court with their respective advocates and present a compromise petition under Order XXIII Rule 3 of CPC.
The contents of the compromise are read over and explained to the parties in Kannada language.

The parties admit that they have entered the compromise voluntarily and that they are aware of the contents of the compromise petition."
Sri
